PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
SELECT ?z ?tp ?set ?zts ?tts ?sts WHERE {
  ?z brick:hasName "Perimeter_bot_ZN_4" .
  ?z brick:hasPoint ?tp .
  ?tp a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature .
  ?z brick:hasPoint ?sp .
  ?sp a brick:Zone_Cooling_Setpoint .
  ?t ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tts . ?t brick:isPointOf ?z . ?t a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature .
  ?s ref:hasTimeseriesId ?sts . ?s brick:isPointOf ?z . ?s a brick:Zone_Cooling_Setpoint .
}

SELECT ?z ?ref ?ts WHERE {
  ?z brick:isSubclassOf* brick:Zone .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?z), "Perimeter_bot_ZN_4") || ( ?z rdfs:label ?l ; FILTER(CONTAINS(str(?l), "Perimeter_bot_ZN_4")) ) )
}
